zones.name: Zone B – VNIT Gate
zones.area: VNIT Main Gate vending bay, South Ambazari Road, Nagpur
rules: Operate only inside the marked zone boundary.
Keep the pedestrian path and VNIT gate access clear.
Display your active vending certificate during operating hours.
Use only your assigned slot and leave the area clean at closing time.

zones.name: Zone A – Futala Lake
zones.area: Futala Lake Promenade, Traffic Park Road, Nagpur
rules: Operate only inside the marked lake-side vending boundary.
No obstruction of the jogging track or lake promenade.
Display your active vending certificate during operating hours.
Maintain cleanliness; no waste disposal near the lake.

zones.name: Zone C – Sitabuldi
zones.area: Sitabuldi Market Area, Civil Lines, Nagpur
rules: Operate only in the designated market vending zone.
Keep main road access and shop frontages clear.
Display your active vending certificate during operating hours.
Follow NMC noise guidelines during peak market hours.

zones.name: Zone D – Dharampeth
rules: Operate only within the designated Ramnagar vending bay.
No vending on main road shoulders or pedestrian crossings.
Display your active vending certificate during operating hours.
Coordinate with NMC inspector for weekly zone compliance check.
